name: monstarx
description: Ship real full-stack apps from Cursor, ChatGPT, and Codex — Cloud backend, Admin CMS, REST APIs, live preview, and publish via MonstarX MCP.

interface.longDescription: Ship real full-stack web apps from your coding agent — not mockups. MonstarX plans, builds, live-previews, and publishes to *.monstarx.app or your domain. Differentiating surface: MonstarX Cloud (database, accounts, email, storage, AI, secrets), Admin panel/CMS on every app, partner REST APIs with OpenAPI, and one-click publish with restoreable versions. Connect once at https://monstarx.com/mcp (OAuth), then push, pull, ask MonstarX to build, set secrets, and publish. Code stays yours — export or sync to GitHub anytime.
defaultPrompt: Push this app to MonstarX and give me the link.
Ask MonstarX to add Stripe checkout, then pull its changes.
